- Photo: Show one picture, with an optional caption. Pick: One picture on its own, optionally captioned. Not several pictures (Gallery) or a photo-led main message with a headline (Hero).
- Player: Listen to or watch one recording, with play, skip and a scrubber. - Sheet: A panel over the screen for more detail, a longer pick or a few extra actions. Pick: More about one thing without leaving the screen, picking from six or more options, or a few extra actions behind the header. Not a message that stays on the screen (Banner), two to five options shown inline (Choice, Chips), or a whole new task (a new screen).
- Sparkline: See how one measurement is changing, alongside its latest value. Pick: One latest value with its recent rise or fall. Not separate amounts per day or category to compare (Bars), or several summary numbers (Stats).
- Stats: Two to four independent summary numbers, with labels, units and optional change arrows. Pick: Several independent summary measurements shown together, with an optional change arrow on each. Not amounts compared across days or categories (Bars), one latest measurement with its recent line (Sparkline), one record's details (KeyValue), one headline number (Hero), or one sum of money (Amount).
- Steps: Know your current place in a short ordered flow. Pick: Show the current position in a short setup or booking flow. Not independent jobs to tick off (Checklist) or progress toward a numeric goal (Ring).

- Timer: Measure time remaining or elapsed, with controls to start and stop. Pick: Time remaining until an activity ends or elapsed since it began. Not a number manually nudged up or down (Counter) or an amount completed toward a goal (Ring).
- ActivityRings: Track multiple daily goals together, never a single daily goal. Pick: Requires at least two distinct daily goals, each with its own value and target, shown as concentric rings. Not a single step, exercise, water or other goal: choose Ring for any one goal, regardless of health context. Not targets drawn as bars (Progress).
- Cycle: Follow logged menstrual periods and locally estimated cycle phases. Pick: A menstrual cycle with period days, today's phase and estimated next period and fertile window. Not progress toward a goal (Ring), or dates merely marked with activity (Calendar).
- Exercise: Learn one exercise's form, muscles and equipment, and recall previous results. Pick: One exercise explained with media, muscles, short form cues and best and last results. Not playing just an exercise video (Player), a lesson in a course (Lesson), or a whole session (Workout).
- HabitGrid: Keep several healthy habits across the seven days of this week. Pick: Several habits by seven weekdays, an editable check per cell and streak per habit. Not one habit's run of days (Streak), today's jobs only (Checklist), or many weeks of activity (Heatmap).
- Measurements: Follow a body measurement's long-term history against a goal across selectable time ranges. Pick: Long body-measurement history with a dashed goal reference, latest value, change and month/quarter/year switching. Not today's weight with a tiny recent trend and no goal or range switching (Sparkline), progress toward a total (Ring), a holding's price (PriceChart), or business series (LineChart).
- Medication: Log today's medicine doses by time, including taken, skipped and remaining pills. Pick: Medicines or supplements on schedule, with doses, taken/skipped marks and refill stock. Not ordinary jobs (Checklist) or nudging one count (Counter).
- SymptomLog: Note several body symptoms and each symptom's severity. Pick: Grouped body symptoms with a selected chip and severity zero to five for each. Not one level for the day (Scale), collection filters (Chips), or naming feelings (Feelings).
